title: Keep the parent’s Stop control visible while a settled delegation result is runnable
outcome: Expose the backend Stop eligibility in the composer for a visible idle parent with a settled, runnable, unpaused delegation fan-in. A user can Stop during the interval between wait settlement and queue promotion from either composer footer.
acceptance: An idle parent with a runnable, unpaused settled delegation result can invoke Stop from both relevant composer footer modes after its wait row disappears.
A paused or non-runnable retained result does not show an active Stop affordance based on that fan-in alone, and existing active-turn, test-run-wait and capacity Stop controls remain usable.
A focused UI regression drives the settlement-to-promotion state and verifies the actual Stop action.
